cohort: Pregnant women infected with listeriosis who delivered infants
finding: Listeria monocytogenes infection in pregnant women was associated with non-specific symptoms, diagnosis primarily through blood culture, and risk factors including HIV seropositivity and anemia, leading to complications such as puerperal infections.
mod_finding: Precipitous labor was described in 39% of women with Listeria infection who had a vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Very low birth weight in 27.4% of neonates
